1.0.0: Initial release. Adds API-key authentication and components for transcripts (Get/Find/List), users (List), media upload, live meeting bot, meeting sharing, soundbites, title updates and deletion, an arbitrary GraphQL call component, and a polling NewTranscript trigger.
1.0.1: Fixed a crash when a Find/List component saved an EMPTY result set to a CSV file — the header row was built from the first record without checking there was one, so a search that legitimately matched nothing failed the flow instead of writing an empty file.
